title: Linda Bradshaw saw and photographed portal at Bradshaw Ranch

tellings.quote: there's allegedly a portal in the Bradshaw Ranch that was seen by the former owner of the ranch Linda Bradshaw. And she actually took photographs of it.

plain: A portal allegedly appeared at Bradshaw Ranch near Sedona, Arizona, and the ranch's former owner, Linda Bradshaw, saw it and took photographs of it. The journalist Ross Coulthart tells Michels this as something he has heard, citing Bradshaw and her photographs, while himself calling the portal "alleged"; if true, it would be a picture of a doorway to somewhere else.
